messages.text:
Happy to. Give me your state (or your order number and I'll pull the address off it), and I'll run it properly.

For reference, the two I'd run it against are the Harlo B30, $899 for about 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, and the Magic Miner 40T, $799 for 40 TH/s, our best value per terahash. If you know your rate per kWh, send that too and I'll use your real number instead of the state average.

Ran these for Germany at your 38 cents a kWh.

Harlo B30, $899: about 42,990 sats a month, worth roughly $36 today. Power costs $112 a month, so you're about $76 a month underwater at today's BTC price. Break-even is BTC at $261,190. Solo block odds about 1 in 219,980 a day, 0.17% over a year.

Magic Miner 40T, $799: about 57,320 sats a month, worth roughly $48. Power is $180 a month, so about $132 a month negative. Break-even BTC $314,395. Jackpot odds 1 in 164,985 a day, 0.22% a year.

Straight answer: at 38 cents, neither pays for its power today. The B30 is the gentler one, 405 W against 650 W, and it holds up better if BTC runs. If you want the lottery ticket and max hashrate, the 40T. Both are pre-sale, B30 October 30, 40T November 14.

One thing on price: those are USD ex-VAT, and they ship from the US warehouse, so 21% import VAT plus any duty is charged on delivery.

Today's estimate, not a promise. Want me to rerun it at a night-rate tariff if you have one?

At 16 cents it looks very different.

Harlo B30: same 42,990 sats a month, worth about $36. Power drops to $47 a month, so you're only about $11 a month short at today's price. Break-even is BTC at $109,975, which is a plausible move, not a fantasy.

Magic Miner 40T: 57,320 sats a month, worth about $48. Power $76, so about $28 a month short. Break-even BTC $132,377.

At this rate I'd take the B30. It's the closer one to break-even and the cheaper one to run, and the sats keep stacking either way. The 40T buys you more hashrate and better block odds for less money up front, if the jackpot shot is what you're in it for.

Want me to put one in a cart?
